meta.title: RepoChan — Turn any git repository into a living brand
meta.description: RepoChan is an LLM-native, local-first, agent-agnostic creative production protocol: your coding agent turns a git repository into a mascot persona and a consistent visual brand.

hero.mediaLabel: Night workshop scene: Repo-chan, a white-haired mascot in a moss-green apron, presses a brass wax seal onto a contract under lamplight.
hero.title1: Turn any git repository into a
hero.lede: An LLM-native, local-first, agent-agnostic creative production protocol. No embedded agent runtime — bring Claude Code, Codex, Pi, Cursor, Hermes, or any shell-capable agent.

paradigm.title: Don’t trust the conversation. Trust what landed on disk.
paradigm.lede: Chat history is weather; artifacts are climate. RepoChan keeps hard constraints in code and creative judgment in prompts — the source of truth is a versioned protocol tree on disk.

compareNo.title: Freestyling into chat
compareNo.body: Agent memory, scrollback and good intentions. Unversioned, unverifiable, unrecoverable.

compareYes.title: Artifact-centric pipeline
compareYes.body: Every role emits a schema-validated, versioned artifact under .repochan/ — atomic writes, no overwrites.

pipeline.title: One sentence in, a full brand out — with three checkpoints
pipeline.lede: You talk to your agent; the wizard skill schedules six roles. Each pause is a human checkpoint, not a formality.

steps.title: Analyst
steps.body: Deterministic scan plus LLM enrichment → analysis report.

steps.title: Interviewer
steps.body: Optional. Structured questions distill taste into an interview report.

steps.title: Creative team
steps.body: Worldbuilder + character designer + consistency guardian → persona.

steps.title: Art director
steps.body: Foundation sheet first, then every downstream asset order.

steps.title: Painter
steps.body: Foundation-anchored rendering; downstream art references the foundation.

steps.title: Page designer
steps.body: Landing page and deploy prep — like this very site.

architecture.title: Four layers of constraints, one thin binding surface
architecture.lede: The stack separates what must be deterministic from what must stay creative. The CLI is the only door.

layers.name: schema
layers.body: Zod schemas gate artifact shape — a gate, not a mirror of taste.

layers.name: protocol
layers.body: Dual-track persistence, safeProtocolPath, atomic writes with EEXIST refusal.

layers.name: entities
layers.body: OrderStatus six-state machine, dependency gates, approval gates.

layers.name: skill
layers.body: Pure markdown judgment: how to run the pipeline, enforced by your agent.

architecture.pkgCaption: Seven packages, one dependency direction: cli → leaves
pkgs: .repochan/ R/W, schema gates, state machine, analysis engine — zero credentials, zero pixels
Sole bin: deterministic subcommands + skill install
prompt → PNG; the only place credentials live
Local pixel ops: slice / bg-remove / GIF
architecture.note: Image libraries never write .repochan/; protocol writes always go through core. Core is zero-credential, zero-agent, zero-pixel by construction.

principles.title: Six design principles, written down like terms
principles.lede: Short, numbered, and binding — the same way the protocol treats every other promise.

clauses.title: Constraints in code, judgment in prompts
clauses.body: Prefer deterministic gates over skill prose.

clauses.title: CLI is the only binding surface
clauses.body: Agents shell out; MCP, if ever, is a thin wrapper over the CLI.

clauses.title: No embedded runtime
clauses.body: There is no repochan run that “thinks”; the wizard skill plus your agent does.

clauses.title: Image libs do not write .repochan/
clauses.body: Bytes out; protocol in only via core.

clauses.title: Credentials stay in image-gen
clauses.body: ~/.repochan/image.json plus env; core and cli never see keys.

clauses.title: Foundation-first consistency
clauses.body: One visual anchor, then reference-driven downstream art.

limits: No CI configuration, no lint configuration ships with the repo.
No stale propagation: editing a persona does not auto-flag dependent orders.
Schemas guarantee “legal”, never “beautiful” — quality lives in skills and review.
The state machine is intentionally rigid; recovery paths are explicit, not magical.
principles.catchphrase: “Say it nicely all you want — it only counts once it’s written down.”
principles.catchphraseNote: Repo-chan, keeper of the Seal Workshop
